component.name: Gittin
component.summary: Write Markdown, notes, code and config files

description.p: Gittin is a writing app for Markdown, notes, code and config files. Open a file or a whole folder, format with a toolbar you already know, and save straight back to the file it came from.

ul.li: Write Markdown, then switch to Preview to read the finished page, with tables, maths, diagrams and emoji
Plain text, JSON, YAML, HTML, CSS, JavaScript and TypeScript open with their own syntax colours
Open a folder, find the file you need and save each one back where it came from
Unsaved changes are kept until you save; Diff shows what changed, and version history keeps your recent saves

description.p: In a folder that is a git repository, saving also records your files in the repository's own history, with a message that says what changed, and Version history lists each file's commits. Start a repository to give any other folder git history. Git is built in, so there's nothing else to install.
There are no accounts, and your files stay on your computer. Gittin reaches only the files and folders you choose, and reads git's own settings for the name and email it records with your saves.

screenshot.caption: Writing Markdown with the formatting toolbar
A folder open beside the document

ul.li: In a folder that is a git repository, saving also commits, with a message that says what changed.
Version history lists a repository file's commits.
Renaming, moving and deleting a file in a repository commit at once.
Start a repository gives any other folder git history.
Quitting asks about every unsaved file.
A pressed list button removes the list.
Pasted links keep their addresses, and a pasted table becomes a Markdown table.
Images from this device can be added to files in a folder, from Insert › Image › From device…, by pasting or by dropping.
Export drafts saves a .zip that holds each draft as its own file.
The side panels and the appearance stay as they were after printing.
Dragging text, typing with input methods and files with mixed line endings work as expected.
Preview shows more unusual Markdown correctly.

description.p: Gittin is now available as a desktop app.
